quarterly_data.signal: Where the silicon constraint sits and how it shapes competition: President and CTO Ken Duda said merchant versus in-house silicon 'isn’t actually the big issue because the bottleneck isn’t the chip designer, the bottleneck is the fab', and that Arista manages allocation through aggressive supply agreements and purchase commitments. He added that 'you do not necessarily get your fair share of the allocation unless you buy the vendor’s turnkey solution' (vendor not named), which pushes lower-volume customers that lack purchase leverage toward a single-vendor solution, while at-scale customers pursue best-of-breed.
